| Deploy on [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy{{!}}Contract Killers]]. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] [[Death Mark]]. At end of opponent’s turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[On The Hunt]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[On The Hunt (Errata 3)]] shares the [[On The Hunt (Errata 2)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
